finalMessage:
Renamed `tax` to `salesTax` and moved it to `src/salestax.ts`, along with its rounding helper. Updated callers, tests, documentation, and trace links.

All 36 tests pass. `ostf check --base main` passes with 111 valid links.

Affected items: `R-TAX-RATE`, `R-TAX-EXEMPT`. No new items. Added links connect `salesTax` to both items and its rounding/exemption tests to their respective items.

Impact tests passed: `salesTax` suite, “rounds half up to the cent,” “is zero for a tax-exempt customer,” and `price > taxes the subtotal after discounts`.
